Prompt.Prompt: EF-REG-011 - Locale-stable currency, compact amount, and date formatting

parameters.elementDescription: The medium-sized 'Dashboard' navigation link in the LEFT sidebar, directly above 'My Expenses' and below the EMPLOYEE heading; it opens the connected dashboard for formatting verification.

The medium-sized 'Finance' navigation link in the LEFT sidebar, below the FINANCE heading and beneath the 'Approvals' link; it opens the connected Finance view for compact and full currency formatting.
The medium-sized 'Dashboard' navigation link in the LEFT sidebar, above 'My Expenses' and below the EMPLOYEE heading; it opens the connected dashboard for fresh formatting evidence.

The medium-sized 'Finance' navigation link in the LEFT sidebar, below the FINANCE heading and beneath the 'Approvals' link; it opens the connected Finance view for compact and full currency formatting.
The medium-sized 'Dashboard' navigation link in the LEFT sidebar, above 'My Expenses' and below the EMPLOYEE heading; it opens the connected dashboard for fresh formatting evidence.

The medium-sized 'Finance' navigation link in the LEFT sidebar, below the FINANCE heading and beneath the 'Approvals' link; it opens the connected Finance view for compact and full currency formatting.

parameters.script: const text=document.body.innerText; const links=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/expenses/"]')).map(a=>({href:a.href,text:a.innerText})).slice(0,5); return {href:location.href, tokens:(text.match(/₹[\d,]+(?:\.\d+[A-Za-z]+)?/g)||[]), compact:(text.match(/₹[\d.]+(?:L|Cr)/g)||[]), dates:(text.match(/\b\d{1,2} [A-Z][a-z]{2} 2026\b/g)||[]).slice(0,10), links};
const text=document.body.innerText; return {href:location.href, amount:text.match(/₹[\d,]+/g)||[], dates:text.match(/\d{1,2} [A-Z][a-z]{2} 2026/g)||[], body:text.slice(0,1200)};
